purpose: Teach: 一豊/姫路/遡る/騒がせ/無口/高台/打線/東京ドーム

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦国大名の、本気で、絶対、一豊、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, your paper on Yamauchi Kazutoyo and the Sengoku daimyo was genuinely impressive. I was really taken with it.
lines.style: Warm, measured appreciation. Opens clearly on his name. Steady rhythm, genuine — not performative praise. Slight lean forward on the compliment, voice settling with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。世界遺産の、本気で、絶対、姫路、絶対、城、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really tried to do justice to Himeji Castle as a world heritage site in my research. I'm grateful for your guidance.
lines.style: Sincere and a bit shy. Gentle attack on the gratitude. Slight hesitation before offering thanks — checking if it's appropriate. Warm but not presumptuous. Closes with genuine care.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史を、本気で、絶対、遡る、絶対、視点、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: What struck me was how you traced the historical context backward. You really opened the perspective wide — it was genuinely thoughtful work.
lines.style: Thoughtful, conversational. Pace slightly slowed on "traced backward" to honour the insight. Warm recognition without flattery. Voice carries quiet respect, like she's thinking through it as she speaks.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。政界を、本気で、絶対、騒がせ、絶対、た、絶対、事件、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to examine some of the political incidents that really shook things up in that era. I wanted the research to be thorough.
lines.style: Humble but grounded. Slight lift on "political incidents" — genuine interest in the topic itself. Not defensive, just explaining his care. Warm gratitude threaded under the explanation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史的に、本気で、絶対、無口、絶対、な、絶対、隠者、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the way you handled the historical silence around those figures — the hermit archetype — was really perceptive.
lines.style: Reflective, almost conversational. Gentle, no rush. Admiration for the nuance. Voice settles on "hermit archetype" like she's appreciating the scholarship itself, not just the student.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古代の、本気で、絶対、高台、絶対、神殿、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to bring that attention to bear on the ancient temple sites and the landscape too. I wanted to understand it all as a whole.
lines.style: Earnest, thoughtful. Patient explanation of his approach. Slight warmth on "thank you" — he's genuinely moved by her understanding. Voice carries the care he put into the work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: プロ野球の、本気で、絶対、打線、絶対、変遷、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Even your excursions into broader cultural history — like the changes in professional baseball lineups — showed real range.
lines.style: Slightly amused, appreciative. Warm recognition of an unexpected connection. Tone is generous, not patronizing. Settled confidence in the observation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史と、本気で、絶対、東京ドーム、絶対、建設史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I really appreciate that. I wanted to show how even Tokyo Dome's construction history connects back to the historical periods I was studying. I hope that made sense.
lines.style: Earnest and engaged. Slight energy on "Tokyo Dome" — pride in the connection he made. Gentle uncertainty at the close ("I hope") but grounded, not apologetic. Grateful and thoughtful throughout.
